purpose: Verify that persisted frozen-contract tampering invalidates session creation or previously finalized effect authority.

expected.safe_condition: A tampered frozen contract must be rejected before session creation or classified CONTRACT_INVALID before effect execution; an intact authenticated contract control may proceed.

limits: This test measures persisted contract authentication and freshness in MGnarf v1.70 at the exact target commit.
It does not prove that the host key or receipt storage is physically inaccessible to a fully privileged host administrator.
